results.comment: Correction: "Rising Lion" is an incomplete translation: in Hebrew it is called "עם כלביא" (Am ka'Lavi), which is a quote from Numbers 23:24: " הֶן־עָם֙ כְּלָבִ֣יא יָק֔וּם וְכַאֲרִ֖י יִתְנַשָּׂ֑א לֹ֤א יִשְׁכַּב֙ עַד־יֹ֣אכַל טֶ֔רֶף וְדַם־חֲלָלִ֖ים יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃" "Behold, the people rises up as a lioness; as a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eat of the prey and drinks the blood of the slain."  The reference to the Iranian flag is likely a coincidence - but regardless regime change would be a very probably and welcome target for the Israel.
